The '''Bombardment of Xorrn''' took place at the end of [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. In the years leading up the the Clone Wars, [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosians]] constructed [[Geonosian hive/Legends|Geonosian hive]] [[Factory/Legends|factories]] in the planet's crust. The factories illegally produced millions of [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] in secret. Shortly after the Clone Wars erupted, the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] discovered the foundries on Xorrn. This led to numerous assaults on the planet, though all failed. At the end of the Clone Wars, the Republic decided Xorrn wasn't worth further losses and ordered an [[Orbital bombardment/Legends|orbital bombardment]] of the droid foundries. This resulted in the loss of dozens of [[Core ship/Legends|Core ships]], picking up droid shipments. At least one factory, [[Foundry Four/Legends|Foundry Four]], survived the bombardment relatively intact.<ref name="Friends" />
